data.name: Jehrana
data.gender_notes: Jehrana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'j-h-r', which signifies 'to glorify, praise, or extol'. The name Jehrana is a beautiful and meaningful Arabic name for girls, reflecting the deep spiritual connection and reverence towards Allah. The name Jehrana carries the meaning “Glorification of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jehrana usually hope their child will grow to embody glorification of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the gentle and graceful nature of Allah and invokes His blessings upon the child.
data.etymology: Jehrana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glorification of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jehrana total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: جهرانا
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الرفعة و العلو في الشأن
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم جهرانا مشتق من الجذر العربي ج-ه-ر، و يعني الاسم الذي يظهر و يرتفع في الشأن، و يدل على قوة و علوية المسمى به. و في بعض التفاسير، يرتبط الاسم بالآية القرآنية 'وَمَا أَفْضَلُ مِنَ الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ' (الأعراف: 206)، حيث يظهر التكبر في الشأن و العلو في المكانة.

in_urdu.name: جہرانہ
in_urdu.meaning: رفعہ اور علو شان کا نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: جہرانہ نام عربی جذر ج-ه-ر سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے وہ نام جو اپنے شان و منزلت میں بلند ہو. یہ نام قوت اور بلندی کا اشارہ کرتا ہے. جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ اس کا استعمال ایک اعلیٰ درجہ کی علامت کے طور پر کیا جاتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: जहराना
in_hindi.meaning: उन्नति और उच्च स्थान का नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: जहराना नाम की उत्पत्ति संस्कृत और अरबी मूल से हुई है। यह नाम ज-ह-र मूल से निकला है, और इसका अर्थ है उत्कृष्टता और उच्च पद। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उच्च सामाजिक दर्जा और सम्मान का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: جهرانا

in_english.meaning: Name symbolizing elevation and high status
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jehrana originates from the Arabic root ج-ه-ر (j-h-r), which means 'to appear' or 'to elevate'. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies a person of high status, power, and nobility. It reflects the Quranic values of elevation and transcendence, as mentioned in Surah Al-A'raf (7:206). The name Jehrana is used across Muslim cultures to denote a person with a strong and elevated presence.
